I found three Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers and sent Pree the list in a reply to her DM. Each one comes with its source:

1. #4409, from Moss's note "Central handoffs next week" (teams/team-central/digests/2026-01-02-central-handoffs.md). It's a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard.
2. #4412, from the same Moss note. It's a driver SMS prompt glitch on unpaved overflow lots.
3. PD-5302, from #central-random. Hollis posted it on Oct 14 as an extra Marrow Fieldworks ticket for a follow-up from this week.

- **Unconfirmed:** In #central-random on Oct 13, Tobias flagged a double-booking on ticket #8841 against an account the thread calls only "Tobias's dealer account". I told Pree it might not be Marrow Fieldworks. It could be: Moss's note says the account changed hands on Jan 5, but nothing names the new owner.
- **Left out:** FR-882 and PD-4821, because they belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account.
- **Search gaps:**
  - The knowledge base refused to search because this connection isn't tied to any member. So the list only covers the channels and files I read directly, all of which Pree can see.
  - Marrow Fieldworks has no account files.
  - #central-team, #general, #help-it-ops and #inc-tansley-carrier-api have no messages this week.
